name: Toratora -Trouble Travel-
source:
A Mystery Sound Novel by Natsukon.

Souji and Sakuna rent a beach house on a solitary island. 
They're loving the vacation, but other visitors start dying one after another. 
Will these two manage to escape with their lives!? 

[Adapted from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE090715.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Natsukon制作的一部悬疑有声小说。

宗次和朔奈在一座孤岛上租下了一间海滨小屋。
二人正享受着假期，其他游客却开始接连死去。
他们最终能否活着逃出生天！？

[改写自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE090715.html]DLsite English[/url]]
